Class AppUser

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.domain.AppUser
public final class AppUser extends Object
Someone who can sign in: an analyst. An account can have a password (for the username/password sign-in), a Microsoft identity (the subject of their Microsoft sign-in), or both. Identified by its UserId; the email is the login name, kept in lower case.
